name: vellum
description: Read, write and search a folder of markdown notes. Notes stay plain .md files on your disk.
long_description:
vellum gives Claude your markdown notes: full-text search that forgives typos and missing accents, tags, tasks, backlinks and conflict-safe edits. The notes stay plain `.md` files in the folder you pick, so Obsidian, VS Code and git keep working alongside. Nothing leaves your computer: no account, no cloud, no database.

This bundle runs the MCP server only. The web UI and the REST API come with the self-hosted server: see the documentation.
